$comment: S1 (kit): the golden and fixture frames this stream moves, each { "cause" } (+ "hash" for a fixture frame) — scripts/golden-ledger.mts. Every mover is one of the plan's declared fleet fixes: the monitor on the 11 desk heroes' final frames, and the neutral ceiling wherever a ceiling is in frame. The credenza and island fixes move nothing (no house stands its Core on one); every other S1 change is behind a new field or defaults: 2.
